comparison_method.baseline: Only economy.plan replaced with source at baseline_commit; all other code and the simulation harness held fixed.
comparison_method.payment: Progressive payment, independent short category queues
comparison_method.map: Fallback map without a supplied terrain layout
comparison_method.scope: Isolates production behavior; does not estimate miner-routing gains, real map income, combat performance, or win rate

changes: Preserve the next tank operating budget before optional support infantry, defenses, and infrastructure
Reduce peacetime fallback/long-route opening rifles; preserve the map-selected guarded opening screen and live-attack response
Keep complete support purchase costs out of the next tank budget
Resume progressively financed refinery growth after a six-tank core to avoid blocking low-income expansion indefinitely
Require a six-tank core and full MCV cost plus tank operating cash before buying an expansion MCV
Keep power, harvester recovery, tank tech, second-factory priority, emergency ground defense and emergency AA support

verification.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_redalert_tank_priority.py tests/test_redalert_armor.py tests/test_redalert_economy.py tests/test_redalert_balance.py tests/test_redalert_policy.py tests/test_redalert_maps.py

reproduction.baseline_loading: Load git show BASELINE_COMMIT:redalert_bot/economy.py in a types.ModuleType with __package__='redalert_bot'; patch redalert_bot.economy.plan with the loaded plan function.
reproduction.scenarios: For faction in ('allies','soviets') and income in (8,16), run mock_production_progression(faction,600,income) once with the baseline patch and once without it.

limitations: Synthetic production counts, not measured match win rates
Assumes fixed income per miner; no harvesting routes, combat losses, ore depletion, or real factory acceleration
The medium-income Soviet scenario has no increase in completed tanks within the 600-second window
